name: opencoreemr/oce-module-sinch-fax-tools-openemr
description: OpenEMR source tree for static analysis (PHPStan) and the local Docker bind mount. Pinned to PUBLIC upstream openemr/openemr rel-810 so analysis resolves the Symfony-Session API the module targets. This module uses only upstream-core symbols, so the public contract is the correct thing to analyze against and no credential is required. Not a runtime dependency of the module — see tools/openemr/README.md.
